parameters.description: Same complete bearded defender #4, elevated southeast view. Preserve helmet, beard, broad shoulders, forward shield and short sword; expressive ready asymmetric stance. Native 64x64 pixel art with clear square clusters, crisp simple shading, no smoothing. Muted blue-grey armor with PALE GREY GREEN TOP EDGE HIGHLIGHTS #7A8687, muted olive trim, earthy brown tabard, warm muted tan face #AC9878 clearly separated from dark beard. Strong dark outline #252C2A for readability on olive terrain. Use supplied palette. Simple large planes, full body with both feet and all gear inside 3px transparent margin. No floor or shadow.
